name: IDEAS II — diffusion MRI and structural connectomes

repo.accession: ds007401 v1.0.0 (raw); processed tensors/connectomes on figshare

access.steps: OpenNeuro download (DataLad/AWS/CLI); processed data via figshare links.

cohort.types: drug-resistant focal epilepsy; IDS aligned with IDEAS

modalities: DWI, 2 protocols: P1 (n=167, 2014–19, GE MR750, 2 mm iso); P2 (n=147, 2009–13, GE Signa HDx, b=1200 s/mm², 52 directions + 6 b0). Multishell for 98 patients and 69 controls
format: BIDS NIfTI + .bval/.bvec; FA/MD maps native + MNI152; connectome matrices
size: ds007401 is 20.5 GB in total (raw); 314 DWI sessions
derived: 80 connectivity matrices per person (det/prob tractography × Lausanne scales 36/60/125/250 × 5 weights × dilated or not); networks for 191 patients and 97 controls
caveats: DWI and T1w sometimes from different sessions (interval <24 months in 69%)
Parcellations are Lausanne/DK, not the 162-region VEP atlas used by VEC; re-parcellate from raw for VEP
51 patients and 29 controls overlap with ENIGMA
checks: Cloned ds007401: 314 .bval/.bvec pairs, CC0 licence, README; full text PMC13285235.
pipeline: The only large open source of patient-specific structural connectomes paired with resection masks and outcomes: the natural 'build' input for an Epileptor/TVB network and a virtual-surgery check.
key_claim: Open DWI for 216 patients + 98 controls with ready connectomes for 191 patients, linked to IDEAS masks and outcomes.

evidence.quote: Open diffusion MRI dataset: 216 individuals with epilepsy + 98 controls, with preprocessing and structural connectomes.
We openly share networks for 191 patients and 97 healthy controls.
In total, we therefore release 80 connectivity matrices per person
